Our surfer design teams have developed these Flip-Flops for water sports enthusiasts, for use before and after their sessions. Suitable for everyone! These simple and practical flip-flops are easy to slip on and take off and are very quick-drying. Perfect for before and after watersports.
foot support: Flat sole. Plastic straps providing minimal foot support.
robustness: Single-layer sole. Reinforced to stop the toe post pulling through
drying time: Drying time: 10 min. Conducted in laboratory conditions at 23°C.
USE EXAMPLES We have designed these flip-flops for very occasional or seasonal use, for surfers walking to spots over short distances (<3 km a day) that are easily accessible: flat land and established paths.
SURFERS and FLIP-FLOPS Flip-flops are the iconic surfer footwear. As well as being the symbol of a sunny surfing lifestyle, they are also the perfect footwear for before and after a session: simple, practical, easy care and above all easy to put on and take off, even with wet feet, without having to use your hands when they are already occupied with your equipment.
USE TESTS Product tested by our teams, in collaboration with external testers, in real-life conditions.
DESIGN At OLAIAN, we design our flip-flops taking inspiration from the needs and requirements of surfers, so that this footwear can suit the vast majority. Product designed by our surfer teams in Hendaye (France). The Olaian global design centre is located on the banks of the River Bidassoa in Hendaye. This allows us to design products in contact with users and in the marine environment.
